mapper.update: UPDATE outbound_order SET execution_authorization_id = #{authorizationId}, status = 'ALLOCATED', version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND id = #{orderId} AND attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'PENDING_AUTHORIZATION' AND (execution_authorization_id IS NULL OR execution_authorization_id = #{authorizationId})
mapper.select: SELECT a.authorization_id FROM outbound_execution_authorization a JOIN outbound_tcc_evidence e ON e.enterprise_id=a.enterprise_id AND e.warehouse_id=a.warehouse_id AND e.attempt_id=a.attempt_id AND e.xid=a.xid AND e.tc_terminal_evidence_ref=a.tc_terminal_evidence_ref AND e.participant_set_hash=a.participant_set_hash AND e.tc_observed_status='Committed' WHERE a.enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND a.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND a.outbound_order_id=#{orderId} AND a.attempt_id=#{attemptId} AND a.authorization_id=#{authorizationId} AND a.state='AUTHORIZED' FOR SHARE
